A fragment of a cast copper alloy Roman Brooch of Langton Down type, Nertomarus sub-type, dating to the first century AD. The fragment comprises the head which has decoration in the form of a moulded collar at the bow, from which emerges an inverted triangle with three incised dots, flanked by scrolls, with trefoils of dots underneath.
